g.text: Momemento is implemented within each indivdual
Concrete Command when needed and is marked by adding
+undo() : void (uses mementoColor to restore previous color)
«constructor» + CreateRectangle(ShapeManager receiver, int width, int height)
+undo() : void (adds the shape saved by mementoShape)
«constructor» + Move(ShapeManager receiver, int newX, int newY)
+undo() : void (uses mementoX and mementoY move back)
«constructor» + Shape(shapeID : int, originX : int, originY : int, color : ShapeColors)
«constructor» + Rectangle(int shapeID, int width, int height)
«constructor» + ValidHandler(ShapeManager receiver, Handler selectChain, Handler nonSelectChain)
All handler classes in chain implements Handler
OrderHandler aggregates all Handlers in the Chain
- MoveHandler if a shape is selected
- CreateCircHandler if no shape is selected
Each Chain Implements the Chain of Responsiblity
